summary: Frontend-only regression on Zayado covering the 7 scenarios of the request: Login carousel desktop (dots + auto-rotate every 6s), Login mobile banner, TheSustain 'bientôt' button + toast + password login non-regression, Admin desktop floating sidebar, Admin mobile burger→drawer→nav, Vendeur floating sidebar, and Onboarding 'Sens & Foi' step (partner phrase, 3 choices, disabled Continue, TheSustainInfo modal, then step 8 'Ton offre'). All 7 scenarios PASSED.

issues: Console: DOM nesting warning — <button> nested in <button> around data-testid=header-mail (DropdownMenuTrigger asChild + inner <button>). Non-blocking, already reported in iteration_1.

Console: React does not recognize the `asChild` prop on a DOM element (spelled lowercase `aschild`). Same root cause as the nesting warning — DropdownMenuTrigger forwarding asChild to a native <button>.

action_items: (Optional) Fix DropdownMenuTrigger asChild wrapping around header-mail to remove DOM-nesting + asChild-prop console warnings.

(Nit) In Admin/Vendeur, document.documentElement carries class 'dark' while the pro page is visually LIGHT (crème). Rendering is correct because .pro-clair.pro-cours overrides, but leaving the global 'dark' class on <html> when the pro pages are in light mode is confusing for anyone inspecting. Cosmetic.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding.jsx is 623 lines with all steps inline — consider extracting each step block into small components for maintainability, especially now that step 7 (Sens & Foi) adds significant JSX.
The header 'button-in-button' hydration warning has now been present across iterations 1 and 2 — should be prioritized as it fires on every page load.

Test.pro login → /app (password login non-regression OK). Auto-rotation of the login carousel occurs every ~6s (verified changing from slide 3 → slide 2 after 7.5s wait).
